reviews.text:
A Lifesaving Team When Your Pet Needs It Most!

I can’t thank Dr. Diana Jones and her amazing team at ER4Pets enough for the exceptional care they provided to our 13-year-old Shiba Inu. We brought her in for two life-threatening emergencies: a severe multiple-coyote attack late one night, and just a few weeks ago, a surprise late night bite from a tiny but vicious rattlesnake. Both times, the team immediately took her in, provided outstanding care, and saved her life.

The facility is clean, and the entire team is professional, compassionate, responsive, and incredibly communicative. They take the time to explain every detail of your pet’s care and patiently answer all your questions, providing reassurance during some of the most frightening moments a pet owner can face.

A heartfelt thank-you to Dr. Diana Jones, Mercedes, Dulce, Ailyn, and Dr. Caruso for their expertise, kindness, and dedication. We are so grateful to have such an outstanding emergency veterinary team available when our beloved girl needed them most. ER4Pets truly is a lifesaver, and I recommend them wholeheartedly!

This place is a great place to go if you don't care about your pet at all and it'll most likely end up deceased. Being the only vet on staff 24/7, she sleeps there and has to be woken up if there is an emergency (if she wakes up). Her not being readily available has cost patients their lives. She is vindictive, the place is disgusting, and her monitoring equipment is out of date. Her book of how to win friends and influence people isn't helping much. Do what's best for your pet and go anywhere else.

I took my dog in at about midnight, they admitted us right away & took very good care of us. They treated us with compassion & urgency, but also were very direct with me when communicating what was wrong & what my options were.

When they took my dog in the back to care for him, I could hear the vet techs baby-talking him & trying to comfort my anxious boy. They even sent us home with a little "certificate of bravery" when I picked him up. They've been so patient with me & answered every one of my questions. I'm so grateful to the whole team.

... On August 14,2023 at around 10pm I carried my babygirl Athena (3 y.o husky shepherd mix) in my arms still breathing suffering a car accident hit to her ribs (hit off large truck tire edge, not ran over flat) I came in the door in tears and extremely worried and she immediately took my dog into a back room (out of my vision) and came out with my dog on a bed and told me I had to say my goodbyes and left me in a room with my dog and the DEATH CERTIFICATE TAKEN BY CAMERA HAD HER EYES LOOKING UP AT THE FLASH WHILE BODY AND HEAD LAYING FLAT ON EXAM TABLE. Absolutely unprofessional and seems illegal to disappear with my dog and then say that's our only option.... RIP my girl since 6 weeks old, gone too young. 😭

DR JONES- HUNGRY FOR MONEY AND EMOTIONLESS AND NO HEART FOR HER PATIENTS EXPERIENCING THE LOSS OF A LOVED ONE.... HORRIBLE, EMOTIONLESS & DRAINED/SHOULD BE RETIRED, NO HEART LEFT OLD LADY JUST WANTS MONEY, AND EXTREMELY UNPROFESSIONAL. If you're a veterinarian have sympathy for someone loosing A LOVED ONE (harder than a human)!

Bring your dog elsewhere if you have the option, read other reviews she is out to get your money with no exact and confirmed diagnosis charging for drops, antibiotics, topical & food at once, GLOVES, CLEANING THE TOOLS.... Do your research if I had my phone that night I would have been elsewhere...

Our dog Brooke somehow caught Pneumonia, they provided the utmost amount of care for her the 24 hours that she was there. She came home a brand new pup. They were extensive in finding out what was wrong with her. Years ago, my other dog Peyton got injured and they gave the same amount of care for her too. It doesn't happen often that an emergency arises, but when it does I feel secure in knowing ER4PETS is here.

I am very disappointed with my experience. My dog was diagnosed with multiple chronic conditions by only a visual examination ..."liver disease", "kidney disease", "cataract"... and the list goes on.  This was said without any clinical testing being performed first, which was very concerning to me. Additionally, the doctor did not seem willing to address an emergency situation, attributing it primarily to my dog’s age. I also did not feel comfortable leaving my dog there overnight due to the overall experience. Paid for nothing done but add even more stress!
*p.s.   Went next day to our Vet clinic and the problem was solved with a simple sinus infection.
Dr. Jones is a very good vet.  She knows her job very well… yes she’s expensive it is an ER facility.  I have had many rescue animals saved due to her care.

I want to express my deepest appreciation to the entire team, and especially to Dr. Diana Jones, for the exceptional care they provided to my dog, Prince, over so many years. Prince was not just a pet, he was a beloved member of our family and the compassion, patience, and dedication shown to him during every visit truly meant the world to us.

Even during his most difficult moments, the doctor Jones treated Prince with genuine kindness and dignity. Her support and guidance helped us make the best decisions for his comfort and well-being, and I will always be grateful for the time and care they invested in him.

Prince recently passed away, and although our hearts are heavy, we find comfort knowing he was cared for by the very best. Thank you for your professionalism, your compassion, and for always treating Prince as if he were your own. Your kindness will never be forgotten.

We love Dr Jones and her clinic!! I live that she gives the best advice and she by instinct understands what’s best. I called and told her about our fog who had an inoperable mass in colon and she recommended we change diet.  He lived 2 1/2 more years.   She will always be our go to vet

WARNING GRAPHIC WOUND PICTURES
When our cat was bitten by a rattlesnake TWICE we didn't know if he would make it. We took Grizwald to Dr Jones on July 5th 2024 and by September he was back to being himself. The bite(s) caused swelling and tissue damage that he has completely recovered from! Those first 2 days she and her staff cared for Griz in the office placing an IV giving antivenom, pain meds,fluids and  antibiotics. He knows he is lucky to have survived and he's living it up with the 8 lives he has left. 😺 Thank you so much for all of your hard work and dedication!
ER4PETS will always be the best choice for your pets. Dr Jones and the staff have always exceeded my expectations. Worth every penny. 😺 …
This place is amazing, they saved my Scrappy.  Thank you very much

Dr. Jones saved my dog's life (again) she knows her stuff, she is just very expensive, like any ER hospital. So don't go here unless you are ready to pay a considerable amount of money.  Imagine paying your personal ER hospital bill upfront. (I wish there was doggie medi-cal)   She will save your pets life. I feel like she is less busy that other day to day vet's offices that sees tons of pets everyday  (not always bad)  so she does remember  your pet's issues and treats accordingly.  I've been taking my dog to her for 13 years.

Everyone here is amazing after a horrible event that happened to my fur baby they saved her and to this day are still helping with her care we love them so much for all they have done and continue to do !!!

Absolutely the worst Vet in all of San Diego. Brought my dog there and they basically killed it. Did nothing but want more and more money, all the while letting the dog die. The worst of the worst when it comes to a Vet
My dog got hip surgery here and they took great care of him! They were super helpful in the aftermath too when we called with questions or concerns.

I want to start this review by saying my dog is currently taking meds & seems to be improving after 2 days from being seen at this clinic. However, I'd look for a different emergency clinic in the future. …

Thank you Dominique for your support of our services!
Dr. Diana Jones
